locations.note: B.J. Blazkowicz and Agent One investigate the SS Paranormal Division at a desert dig site by an invented village.
Castle Wolfenstein, the village below it and the bombed city of Kugelstadt are invented places in wartime Germany.
Deathshead's X-Labs facility lies somewhere in Norway; the game never names the town.
Operation Resurrection begins with a parachute drop at Paderborn and the nearby Bramburg dam.

routes.name: B.J.'s mission
routes.note: The story returns to Castle Wolfenstein for the finale.
